source_notes.detail: Both official originals contain the hydrogen synonym. It is translated as written; later occurrences of carbon tetrachloride are translated as 사염화탄소. No silent source correction or added PDF note.

source_notes.example: CID1846 maps to two mathematical italic T characters; MuPDF exposes one painted glyph plus a same-origin zero-width gid=-1 extraction continuation.
source_notes.detail: All original CID, CMap, font and Form bytes remain native. The suppressor validates the full read-only cluster and never suppresses selected multi-Unicode CID clusters.

Celsius glyph and chemical H2O formula remain native, including their source fallback fonts. Korean prose replacing the MS-PGothic sentence uses the matching sans role; Times prose uses serif. Plain T/P coordinate labels and parentheses are independently protected.
